description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'Log' that wraps Android's native Log utility. It provides static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages linkage with a LogNode for custom logging behavior.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging messages, wrapping Android's native Log and supporting custom LogNode chains.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode instance to which logs are dispatched.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which subsequent log messages will be sent.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, optionally with an exception.
